description: Edits a task as a person can on its row: title, description (details), due_date (ISO 8601 with offset, or null to clear), priority, client_id or conversation_id (null unlinks). Send only the fields to change. A flow-step task shifts its later steps when its due time moves, as in the app. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the task, reports what the original call applied, and changes nothing if the task changed since.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: update_task
title: Edit a task
